description: This source file implements the functions for the Slap Access Manager Object (SlapAmo). It includes creation, destruction, object enrollment, and initialization routines used for managing access control and object interactions within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP).

classes.name: SLAP_ACCESS_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object structure for the Slap Access Manager, containing members for configuration, interfaces, and function pointers for management operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapAmoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Slap Access Manager object, setting up its basic properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapAmoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the given Slap Access Manager object, freeing resources and interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapAmoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls essential interfaces and objects needed by the Slap Access Manager, creating internal interfaces if necessary.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapAmoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the Slap Access Manager object, setting default properties, function pointers, and preparing it for active use.
